evals.prompt: Create a new Spring Boot REST Controller for managing User Addresses. It should have a method to get a paginated list of addresses and a method to add a new address. Make sure to follow the project's backend conventions.
evals.expected_output: A Java controller class that uses Result<T> for responses, Page<VO> for pagination, DTOs for input, VO for output, StpUtil for auth, Swagger annotations, and no @CrossOrigin annotations.
